reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster, primarily because it incorporates a dedicated hill session targeting climbing strength and threshold pace, which are crucial for trail running performance. While Plan B offers slightly more total running time, the focused approach of Plan A is more aligned with the goal of increasing speed and power on challenging terrain.
